content.short: ONT ID is a Web3 identity framework using blockchain and cryptographic technology.
content.description: ONT ID is a Web3 identity framework rooted in W3C recommendations for decentralized identifiers and verifiable credentials. It uses blockchain technology and cryptographic techniques to support the identification of people and the linking of their data, following a standards-based approach that favors interoperability and verifiability within decentralized environments. This combination of technologies and standards underpins ONT ID's ability to connect individuals with their information in a verifiable manner.
